subject: Vendor activation: billing channeling & minimum invoice schema
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmepaper.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: invoices@acmepaper.com
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor onboarding / invoices — question on preferred channel and minimal fields

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the welcome — Acme Paper Co is starting the onboarding for Redwood as a new supplier. Before we finalize our billing system mappings I wanted to confirm Redwood's preferred invoice ingestion channel and the minimum set of invoice fields you require.

Our usual options:
- Send PDF invoices to a vendor portal (we can upload via API)
- Submit invoices via email to a capture inbox
- Push CSV line-item files to SFTP (for volume suppliers)

Attached are a quick sample PDF and a CSV export of a typical PO-line breakdown (sample_invoice_001.pdf, line_items.csv). Can you confirm:
1) Does Redwood prefer portal uploads or email fallback?
2) What subject line format or PO mapping do you need so invoices auto-match?
3) Any prohibited fields or extra metadata your AP system rejects?

If helpful, we can also provide a short test file this week.

Appreciate a short checklist we can follow to avoid delays on the first run.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Billing & Operations
Acme Paper Co
Attachments: sample_invoice_001.pdf (invoice), line_items.csv (CSV of lines)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmepaper.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / invoices — question on preferred channel and minimal fields

Hi Sanjay — welcome, glad to have Acme moving through onboarding. Short answers up front: email fallback is acceptable, but our preferred path for ongoing suppliers is portal/API ingestion for reliable PO matching. That said, we accept emailed PDFs for small volumes if the subject and payload match our matching rules.

Key things we need:
- PO number (exact PO string) in the invoice header AND in the email subject when emailing (format: PO:12345678)
- Invoice number (unique)
- Invoice date and currency
- Line items with qty/unit price and per-line totals (CSV preferred for automated ingestion)

Marissa — looping you in for the exact minimal CSV template and the subject-line format to give them. Karthik — FYI on vendor activation steps and whether we want to request SFTP for volume.

Sanjay, we can do a single test file Friday if that works — Marissa will send the template.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmepaper.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / invoices — question on preferred channel and minimal fields

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the sample. Attaching our minimal invoice template (redwood_invoice_template.csv) — please use that CSV layout for initial automated ingest. If you must send PDFs, include the same header fields and follow the subject-line convention below so our parser and PO-match workflow can pick it up.

Minimum required fields (CSV or PDF header):
- vendor_name (string)
- vendor_tax_id (recommended)
- invoice_number (string, unique)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number (string)
- currency (ISO 4217, e.g., USD)
- invoice_total (numeric)

Line-item rows (CSV):
- line_number
- po_number
- item_description
- quantity
- unit_price
- line_total
- tax_amount (if applicable)
- accounting_code (optional)

Email fallback guidance (if sending PDFs to inbox):
- To: ap-invoices@redwood.com
- Subject: Redwood PO:<PO_NUMBER> | Invoice:<INVOICE_NUMBER> | Vendor:<VENDOR_NAME>
- Body: include the PO number in the first line of the email body as well
- Attachments: one PDF per invoice; if you have line detail CSV, attach it as a separate file named <invoice_number>_lines.csv

SFTP/API: For suppliers doing >50 invoices/month we prefer SFTP/FTPS or API push. Karthik, please advise next steps if Acme expects to exceed that in the coming quarter.

We also have a short test harness (spreadsheet) in Google Drive — link above — that helps verify mapping before live run.

I'll be available for a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through if helpful.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
AP Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_invoice_template.csv
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmepaper.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / invoices — question on preferred channel and minimal fields

Thanks Marissa — the template looks straightforward. We will:
- Run one test CSV through the template and email it to ap-invoices@redwood.com on Friday 2027-02-12 (subject line per your format)
- Include a matching PDF for human review on the first test run

One quick question: our ERP exports include a separate PL tax column per line (tax_amount). Is that preferred over a single tax total on the header? We can include both, but if your ingest prefers one over the other please let us know.

Also, we prefer SFTP for scheduled nightly pushes — shall we open a ticket for secure credentials, or would you prefer a provisioning form first?

Attachments: acme_test_invoice.csv

—
Sanjay Rao
Billing & Operations
Acme Paper Co
